elements.text: Service Agreement SA-2026-0042 · Summary for the customer

This document summarises the managed analytics service that Aurora Data Services SRL provides to the customer. It is also a demonstration of an accessible, tagged PDF that is produced with JasperReports and a PDF/UA post-processing step.

The summary is generated automatically from our contract system. Every heading, paragraph, image and link carries a tag, so that a screen reader can announce the structure of the document and not only its text. Background information on accessible documents is published by the W3C Web Accessibility Initiative.
We collect the operational data of the customer every night, analyse it for trends and anomalies, and deliver a report before the start of the next working day.

elements.alt: Process diagram with three consecutive steps: 1. Collect, 2. Analyse, 3. Report.

The chart shows the measured availability of the reporting platform for the first six months of 2026. The dashed line marks the agreed target.

elements.alt: Bar chart of monthly availability in 2026: January 99.20 percent, February 99.60, March 99.90, April 99.70, May 99.95 and June 99.90 percent. The target of 99.50 percent was missed only in January.

children.text: “The platform is available at least 99.5 percent of the time in every calendar month.”

elements.text: Figure 2: Monthly availability, January to June 2026, with the service level commitment quoted next to it.
